gaps.sentence: It's not worth ___ about the delay — nothing will change.

gaps.explanation: pretend + to-infinitive; negative: not to hear.

gaps.sentence: I tried ___ the shelf up, but it was too heavy.
gaps.explanation: try + to-infinitive = attempt, make an effort.

gaps.sentence: I really can't afford ___ on holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: afford takes the to-infinitive: can't afford to go.

gaps.sentence: We expect ___ the results by Friday.
gaps.explanation: expect takes the to-infinitive: expect to receive.

gaps.sentence: She suggested ___ the meeting until Monday.
Remember ___ your passport to the airport.
gaps.explanation: remember + to-infinitive = not forget to do something.

gaps.sentence: The burglar admitted ___ through the kitchen window.
gaps.explanation: 'Admit' is followed by a gerund: admitted climbing.
